story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Playing for the audience: communicating from the bandstand

blocks.x: Music expresses a whole gamut of a person's emotional capability; it can be deep, it can be shallow, it can be everything, and that's the relationship, the drama, the fact that it can do this. Also in poetry, the relationship to poetry, it loses the time element, the lyrics (inaudible).
Didn't we talk about this before?

I seem to remember saying--mentioning that lyrics are an edge of poetry, not of music and a popular misconception is that lyrics are music; they're not, they're part of poetry. Music is an art of putting sound and rhythm together, time and space. (inaudible)
I'd like to have my hearing in twenty five years.

Have you heard the work of any composers and arrangers say in the jazz or popular music field since you had Sauter-Finegan, where you thought they may have picked up on some of the concepts that you and Bill had?
I never thought of it that way. I'm always looking for someone to come and do what we tried to do, and I haven't heard anybody do that yet.
Philosophy, a record company are all factors.
